citations.quote: The tetracycline class of antibiotics work by inhibiting protein synthesis by binding to the 30s subunit of the bacterial ribosome. This class also has notable anti-inflammatory effects, including inhibiting chemotaxis and metalloproteinase activity.
The mechanism of action of sarecycline in treating acne vulgaris is not known.
Sarecycline is a novel tetracycline-class narrow spectrum antibiotic developed for potential treatment of acne vulgaris.
